messages:
maria: Proposal: late RC cut for feature/async-kv + optional DB toggle. Need quick signoff and pinned artifact.
raj: Late cut? what motivated this?
maria: Perf win for heavy prefix workloads. Small migration (toggle) that we can keep off until promo. Dev tested, needs one extra integration smoke.
kai: What's the rollback plan if KV migration causes tail latency?
maria: Rollback plan: 1) Immediately flip feature flag off 2) Rollback to pinned build v2026.03.09-rc3 if flag flip insufficient 3) DB migration script is reversible.
sheriff: I want explicit commands and who runs them.
ops-runner: Adding runbook snippet below (we'll keep it in ops-runbook too):

ops-runner: ```bash
# flip ff
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN\" https://flags.redwood/api/flags/async-kv -d '{\"state\":\"off\"}'
# rollback service
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=registry.redwood/inference:v2026.03.09-rc3
# verify
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference
```

maria: TL;DR: Can we do a pinned RC, manual canary (10%), holdback for 30m, then promote to 50/100 with telemetry gates?
raj: OK with manual canary + pin. Who will run the canary?
kai: I can run initial canary and monitor latency dashboards + tail-percentiles.
sheriff: I’ll be on call for first 60m post-promote. If error-rate > 0.5% or p99 > 400ms we abort to holdback.
deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: candidate v2026.03.09-rc4 -> staging at 2026-03-09T15:20Z. To promote run `/deploy promote v2026.03.09-rc4 --pin --manual-canary`
maria: Ping @deploy-bot can you set the promo window 15:45-16:30 UTC and lock auto-promote?
deploy-bot: Promo window set 2026-03-09T15:45Z - 2026-03-09T16:30Z. Auto-promote disabled.
raj: Artifact pin: registry tag v2026.03.09-rc4 pinned in release-manifest.ops, @maria please confirm checksum matches.
maria: checksum verified: sha256:9f8b...e3a2. Pinned.

kai: Observability checklist before canary: KV warm, traces sampling up, synthetic smoke hitting new endpoints. I’ll run KV warm script.

ops-runner: KV warm snippet: `python tools/kv_warm.py --endpoint prod --keys 10000`

maria: If canary looks good at 10% after 30m, we lift to 50%. If still green after 20m, full promote. Otherwise rollback to pinned.

sheriff: Confirmed. I want the rollback command ready in chat and a single person authorized to execute (kai or raj).
kai: I will be canary lead and authorized to execute rollback if I see the thresholds breach.

raj: Minor ask: add a healthcheck gating rule to the deploy job: require trace-error-rate < 0.3% and p99 < 350ms.
maria: Added to deployment job.

deploy-bot: Note: there's a pending DB schema migration PR attached to this RC (migrations/2026-03-09/async_kv.sql). Migration is gated behind feature flag. Auto-run disabled.

raj: Good. Keep migration off during canary.
maria: Agreed. We will enable migration only after full promote and a separate maintenance window.

sheriff: One more: release notes blurb please (short).
maria: Release notes: \"async-kv: prefix-aware KV cache offering 35% median latency improvement for long prefix workloads. DB migration optional + feature-flagged. See docs/async-kv for rollout.\"

ops-runner: I'll paste rollback command in the ops channel at promo time and pin it.

maria: Final ask: can we have a 15 minute quiet window before the promo to ensure no other major deploys?

deploy-bot: Quiet window enforced 15 minutes before promo.

raj: All set from infra side.
kai: I'll start warm + smoke at 15:30Z.
sheriff: I’ll be watching. GL everyone :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — promoting manually per plan.
